title: Newhaven-Dieppe, steerage passenger.
html_source:
In traveling to Paris, Stephen’s passage across the Channel was from Newhaven in East Sussex to Dieppe on the Normandy coast.

Steerage is in the lower deck, the cheapest ticket.

Stephen makes ironic mention of his own “flight” to Paris with several images of falling (Icarus) or moving very low (steerage, the lowflying lapwing) to berate himself at his failures in Paris and his return to Dublin.
